name: arithmetic-trace
purpose: Measure repeated JavaScript binary64 arithmetic and exact displayed precision instead of hand-simulating numeric boundaries.
pre_prompt: Supply initial, operations and optional repeat (default 1). Operations run in order, then repeat on the previous result. Use a concrete arithmetic hypothesis, not project paths or code. At most 32 operation results are allowed. This uses JavaScript Number arithmetic, not exact decimal/rational arithmetic.
post_prompt: Treat these as measured numeric values. A tiny positive residual is not zero. This trace does not execute the application's branching or timing behavior. Verify any application hypothesis with a focused diagnostic in the declared test scope, preserving acceptance. Do not conclude that source is stale merely because a mental calculation disagrees.
